BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.

2. When learning Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.1 Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Dr, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.1 Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Dr.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.1 Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Dr.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.1 Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Dr.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.1 Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Dr.

3. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Remove all guards

4. When learning Site Preparation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Site Preparation.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Site Preparation.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Site Preparation.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Site Preparation.

5. When learning Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floors 4.0 Building Services 4.1 Plu, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floors 4.0 Building Services 4.1 Plu.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floors 4.0 Building Services 4.1 Plu.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floors 4.0 Building Services 4.1 Plu.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floors 4.0 Building Services 4.1 Plu.

6. When learning Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Aided Drawing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Computer Aided Drawing.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Aided Drawing.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drawing.

7. When learning Introduction to Building Construction, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Building Construction.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Building Construction.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Building Construction.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Building Construction.

8. When learning Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Drawing 3.0 Building Construction Processes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Drawing 3.0 Building Construction Processes.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Drawing 3.0 Building Construction Processes.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Drawing 3.0 Building Construction Processes.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Drawing 3.0 Building Construction Processes.

9. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

10. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

11. When learning Concreting, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Concreting.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Concreting.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Concreting.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Concreting.

12. When learning Timbering, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Timbering.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Timbering.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Timbering.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Timbering.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Plumbing Tools and Equipment 4.2 Plumbing Materials 4.3 Pipework Page 15 of 51 1 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Plumbing Tools and Equipment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Plumbing Materials 4.3 Pipework Page 15 of 51 1 STRAND 1.0: FOUNDATION OF BUILDI and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Plumbing Materials and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
